pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(piano instrumental, soft rising atmosphere)

The lights wait in the quiet room
a stage breathing slowly
before the first note begins

[Verse 1]
I step onto the stage again
under a gentle light
taking one long breath
that trembles in my chest

My fingers shake a little
but that is alright
tonight this song
is finally for me

[Pre-Chorus]
Somewhere inside the silence
my heartbeat answers back

[Chorus]
I stand again
one small step forward
while the piano moves the air

My voice rises softly
through the room
like a window opening

Hands in the air tonight
a new beginning
starting here

[Verse 2]
Yesterday's tears
have already dried
somewhere behind the curtain

In the mirror
someone is smiling
a version of me
I almost forgot

The fear I carried
rests on the floor
while the melody
walks beside me

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo, hopeful and flowing)

[Bridge]
If tears appear again
they can stay

Even laughter
may tremble with them

Because this moment
is enough

A small life
opening again

[Chorus]
I rise again
a little higher now
while the piano carries my voice

The ceiling feels wider
the air feels bright

And somewhere above
my quiet song travels

Hands lifted together
a new beginning
starting here

[Outro]
(soft uplifting piano outro)

I woke again

a gentle morning
inside my heart
